questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.explanationEn: Accommodation is spelled with double c and double m.
questions.explanationHi: Accommodation की सही वर्तनी में double c और double m आते हैं।

questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.explanationEn: Modern means relating to the present or recent times; it contrasts with ancient.
questions.explanationHi: Modern का अर्थ वर्तमान या हाल के समय से संबंधित है; यह ancient का विलोम है।

questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.questionEn: Select the correct verb: “She ___ to work every day.”
questions.questionHi: सही क्रिया चुनें: “She ___ to work every day.”
questions.explanationEn: With third-person singular subject “she” in the simple present, use “goes.”
questions.explanationHi: Simple present में third-person singular “she” के साथ “goes” आता है।

questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.explanationEn: Concise means short and expressing much in few words.
questions.explanationHi: Concise का अर्थ कम शब्दों में संक्षिप्त रूप से कहना है।

questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.questionEn: Identify the noun in the sentence: “Honesty is valued.”
questions.questionHi: वाक्य में संज्ञा पहचानें: “Honesty is valued.”
questions.explanationEn: Honesty is an abstract noun naming a quality.
questions.explanationHi: Honesty एक भाववाचक संज्ञा है, जो गुण का नाम बताती है।

questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.questionEn: Choose the correct article: “He is ___ honest person.”
questions.questionHi: सही article चुनें: “He is ___ honest person.”
questions.explanationEn: Use “an” before a vowel sound; the h in honest is silent.
questions.explanationHi: honest में h मौन है और शुरुआत स्वर-ध्वनि से होती है, इसलिए “an” आएगा।

questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.questionEn: Choose the correct passive form: “The chef prepared the meal.”
questions.questionHi: सही passive form चुनें: “The chef prepared the meal.”
optionsEn: The meal was prepared by the chef.
The meal is prepare by chef.
The chef was prepared by the meal.
optionsHi: The meal was prepared by the chef.
The meal is prepare by chef.
The chef was prepared by the meal.
questions.explanationEn: Simple past active changes to was/were + past participle in passive voice.
questions.explanationHi: Simple past passive में was/were + past participle प्रयोग होता है।

questions.subject: english-grammar
questions.explanationEn: The apostrophe marks the contraction “Let's,” and the comma addresses “children.”
questions.explanationHi: Let's में apostrophe लगता है और बच्चों को संबोधित करने के लिए comma आता है।
